candidates.name: Sarcoidosis
support_spans: Diffuse infiltration of the face with loss of skin creases and diminished facial hair
Multiple asymptomatic nodules without ulceration on upper arms
Numerous acid-fast bacilli present (acid-fast stain)
candidates.why: The combination of skin nodules, joint symptoms, and lymph node enlargement, along with the presence of acid-fast bacilli, suggests Sarcoidosis.

candidates.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
support_spans: Swelling and painful hand joints for 13 months
Rheumatoid factor: 70.1 IU/mL (significantly elevated)
X-ray and joint ultrasound showed: osteoarthritis, synovitis, flexor tendon tenosynovitis, and bone erosions
candidates.why: The presence of swollen and painful joints, significantly elevated rheumatoid factor, and imaging findings of synovitis and bone erosions support Rheumatoid Arthritis.

candidates.name: Leprosy
support_spans: Gradual hair loss of the eyelashes, eyebrows, beard, and scalp for 4 years
Numerous acid-fast bacilli present (acid-fast stain)
candidates.why: The presence of gradual hair loss and numerous acid-fast bacilli, which are indicative of Mycobacterium leprae, suggest Leprosy.
